lines.text: The root is Mov! Mobile, motivate.
Motivate: give a reason to move.
Quick quiz! Which means give a reason to move?
Motivate! It means give a reason to move.

words.ex: Please switch your mobile phone to silent.
A good teacher knows how to motivate students.
